findings.message: CRITICAL: All three UC artifacts (UC-1: artifactId 6, UC-2: artifactId 7, UC-3: artifactId 8) have the exact same content_hash 'def4735c95e1508f08172e467be6c8dbfdb565f166102b7652bd0a61466b80d2'. This violates data integrity requirements - each distinct artifact must have a unique hash based on its actual content. The file docs/requirements/REQ-001/02-use-cases.md contains three different use cases but the artifacts were incorrectly tracked with identical hashes.

UC-2 (artifactId 7) has identical content_hash to UC-1, but describes a different use case 'System Startup' with different actor, preconditions, and flows. Each artifact must hash its own distinct content section.

UC-3 (artifactId 8) has identical content_hash to UC-1 and UC-2, but describes a different use case 'Automated Docking Test' with different actor, preconditions, and flows. Each artifact must hash its own distinct content section.
